none: PAS NLM-BCF938: Roman Coin: Denarius of Faustina II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius of Faustina II (147-175), RIC vol. 3 no. 688, Mint of Rome. Obverse description: Bust right coiffed and diademed, probably draped, Reece period 7. Obverse inscription: FAVSTINA AVGVSTA. Reverse description: Juno standing left with vertical sceptre and patera, peacock to left. Reverse inscription: I V N O. Diameter: 19.6mm, Weight: 2.84gms, die axis: 12
